Title: Public preview: Azure Active Directory B2C supports 36 languages

Body.Content:
Take advantage of language customization in Azure Active Directory B2C to make your experience available in up to 36 languages. You can:

  • Request a language by using the ui_locales OIDC parameter.
  • Create a list of supported languages that adapt to your customer’s browser language.
  • Upload customizations for any string and any language.

Learn more about language customization in our documentation.
